en.headline: Food delivery rider injured in Yuen Long motorcycle collision
en.dek: A non-Chinese male rider suffered hand and leg abrasions after his motorcycle collided with a private car at a junction on Tuesday night.
body: A food delivery rider was injured after his motorcycle collided with a private car in Yuen Long on Tuesday night, The Standard reported.

The accident occurred around 10pm when a private car travelling along Ma Tin Road turned right into Kau Yuk Road and collided with the motorcycle at the junction. The non-Chinese male rider was thrown from his motorcycle and fell onto the road, suffering abrasions to his hands and legs. He was taken to Pok Oi Hospital conscious.

Photos circulating online showed the motorcycle carrying a foodpanda insulated bag, which had opened in the accident, with a delivery order scattered on the road. Several passers-by went to check on the rider's injuries and apparently called police. The private car was left across the road.

A witness said the rider was delivering food at the time. According to Google Street View, there is a give-way line where Ma Tin Road turns right into Kau Yuk Road, and the witness suspected someone failed to stop at the line, causing the accident. The cause and liability are still under investigation by police.

zh.headline: 元朗私家車與外賣電單車相撞 送遞員手腳擦傷送院
zh.dek: 周二晚約十時，馬田路右轉入告由路的私家車與電單車相撞，非華裔男送遞員被拋出後擦傷，送博愛醫院時清醒。
body: 《英文虎報》報導，一名外賣送遞員周二晚在元朗駕駛電單車時，與一輛私家車相撞受傷。
事發於晚上約十時，一輛私家車沿馬田路行駛，右轉入告由路時在交界處與電單車相撞。該名非華裔男司機被拋離電單車，堕落路面，手部及腳部擦傷。他被送往博愛醫院時意識清醒。
網上流傳的照片顯示，電單車上載有foodpanda的保溫袋，袋在意外中打開，送遞訂單散落路面。多名路人前往查看司機傷勢，並疑似報警。私家車則橫擱在路中。
一名目擊者表示，司機當時正在送遞食物。根據Google街景，馬田路右轉入告由路處設有讓路線，目擊者懷疑有人未有在讓路線停下，導致意外。警方正調查事故原因及責任。
